cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our raffle draw was impeccably random.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For filing. You can fold all the tickets for the next draw.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can feel which ticket is yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you can do the next draw. Hand out this round's prizes first.

reason: A grants B future fold and draw control in response to tactile evidence, while concealing the fold as filing and continuing to enforce the current result.
